item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. We refuse to sacrifice irreplaceable life for corporate extraction. Deep-sea mining must be stopped before it starts.

2. We cannot mine the deep ocean without destroying life found nowhere else. Commercial deep-sea mining will drive hundreds of species extinct. We must protect these ecosystems—not tear them apart.

3. Extinction is not an acceptable price for minerals. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, hundreds of deep-sea species will vanish forever. We are calling for a stop to this destructive industry before it starts.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are clear: if commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. The ocean’s darkest depths are not empty wastelands; they are living ecosystems filled with extraordinary creatures, many found nowhere else. Mining would tear through habitats that took millennia to form, turning irreplaceable life into collateral damage for corporate extraction. We refuse to accept extinction as the price of minerals. That is why we are calling for commercial deep-sea mining to be stopped before it starts. Together, we can defend the deep ocean and keep this destructive industry from crossing a line that cannot be uncrossed.
